map.VO2max 数值代表什么？: What does the VO2max value represent?
map.每公斤体重每分钟最大摄氧能力（ml/kg/min），是心肺耐力的金标准。普通成年: The maximum oxygen uptake per kilogram of body weight per minute (ml/kg/min), the gold standard of cardiorespiratory endurance. Ordinary adult men are about 35-45 and women about 30-40; high-level endurance athletes can exceed 60. It declines naturally with age.
map.怎么提高最大摄氧量？: How do I improve VO2 max?
map.以中高强度持续有氧（跑步、骑行、游泳）为主，加入间歇训练（如 4×4 分钟高强度: Focus on sustained moderate-to-high-intensity aerobic exercise (running, cycling, swimming) and add interval training (e.g. 4×4 minutes of high intensity) to improve faster; regular training shows clear gains in 8-12 weeks, aided by sleep and recovery.
